function setHeightVar(c): void

Defined in: website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/sizing.ts:362

Publishes --carousel-item-height on the enclosing

and --carousel-media-height on the host: the aspect-corrected height ensuring all slides share one uniform height. In mixed carousels on mobile, the uniform height anchors to the shortest portrait item. The published height is also capped at the smallest natural item height — the strip may be less tall than the projection, but no slide may ever render taller than its source file's real pixels.

Parameters

c

CustomCarousel

The CustomCarousel element.

void
